content:
**
Spartan Weaponry Addon Toolkit 是一個庫，讓創建 [Spartan Weaponry](https://modrinth.com/mod/spartan-weaponry) 的擴充套件變得輕鬆自如。
** ![Logo banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8e635bf06a942326908c05bf879e993e7e6658b4.png) **Spartan Weaponry Addon Toolkit** 允許僅通過指定材料來自動註冊整套武器。此工具包還處理數據生成，包括標籤、物品模型和配方。此外，它解決了 Spartan Weaponry API 中存在的幾個問題。 如果您有興趣在您的模組中使用這個庫，請查看 [GitHub 頁面](https://github.com/KreloX/SpartanToolkit)（開發中）。 **已用於：** - [Spartan Weaponry: Ice and Fire](https://modrinth.com/mod/spartan-weaponry-ice-and-fire) - [Spartan Weaponry: Aether](https://modrinth.com/mod/spartan-weaponry-aether) - [Spartan Weaponry: Twilight Forest](https://modrinth.com/mod/spartan-weaponry-twilight-forest) - [Spartan Weaponry: Undergarden](https://modrinth.com/mod/spartan-weaponry-undergarden) - [Spartan Weaponry: Blue Skies](https://modrinth.com/mod/spartan-weaponry-blue-skies) - [Spartan Weaponry: SimpleOres](https://modrinth.com/mod/spartan-weaponry-simpleores) - [Spartan Weaponry: Gobber](https://modrinth.com/mod/spartan-weaponry-gobber)
